QUOTE: On an installation without the bash and cmake grammars, shell and CMake fall back to path-only rows with no error. The docs say the miss report names those types, but the code I read does not support that.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the installation degrades without error, but it explicitly denies that the not-indexed report names those types and doesn't describe a capability gate. The item's conclusion that those file types are reported as not indexed is contradicted.
